purpose: Adopted Factory/Agency design obligations within the existing #65 UX source projection; no new stories, schema, runtime or evidence store.
standing: design-commitment; owner explicitly validated in chat on 2026-09-14 and commissioned publication

factory289.policy: Full adopted design governs these scoped episodes; source mapping is not execution or human EX. Existing native story definitions and other obligations are retained.

obligations.requirement: Ordinary work has the four-plane companion; Factory has centre conversation/Run/workspace and right actual artifacts. Preserve selected work/output across related tabs, explicit Run change, one visible transcript/composer, draft/focus, detach/redock, leave/re-entry and restart.
required_branches: Background completion never moves layout or selection.
Selecting a Surface never redirects the Agent or discloses source.
Ordinary centre chat returns to sidecar without duplication.

obligations.requirement: Readable Project roster, personal/Project scope, intent-first create/review/use, reusable team and temporary formation, bounded child with subject/effects/verification/return/lifecycle; Keep as Agent crosses native durable-source recognition.
required_branches: No raw refs as ordinary create inputs.
Temporary participant does not require invented durable profile.
Unavailable team member remains represented.

obligations.requirement: One compact Direct/Factory session interaction resolving Agent, admitted harness/edition, real Model selection policy/routes, environment/worktree/host, repertoire, context and permissions together; existing Continue is immediate.
required_branches: Changing harness/task re-resolves model and tool eligibility.
Change timing is now/reconnect/new session as natively supported.
Unavailable route or credential gets precise recovery, not invented World/authority.
Resident selector does not stand in for full Model roster integration.

obligations.requirement: Inspect and use selected/projected/confirmed-effective/blocked/unavailable praxis and actual disclosed versus eligible context. Useful source-dependent work proves required material and capability reached the selected session.
required_branches: Projection-file write alone does not prove loading.
Unavailable loading readback is labelled, not guessed.
Method stays within current Skill identity/classification and nested SkillSets.
Excluded/private material is not disclosed by selection.

obligations.requirement: Real multiparty To:/@ recipient interaction, attributed messages, selected attachments/skills, semantic coalesced activity, real permission/interrupt and failed-send draft recovery; address, session contribution and bounded delegation retain distinct effects.
required_branches: A second Agent actually acts; one model impersonating voices fails.
Membership/mention does not grant invocation authority.
Keyboard selection/removal/Escape/focus restoration works.
Historical replay is not new live work or duplicated conversation.

obligations.requirement: Substantial work becomes an actual artifact discoverable from chat/work while short conversation links to it; background cue preserves chosen material, explicit show opens right, ordinary pane controls relocate the real Surface.
required_branches: Reviewed revision remains fixed while a newer result becomes available.
Switching related work tabs retains output selection.
Close view retains artifact; detach/redock preserves identity.
Selection or receipt never counts as human agreement.

obligations.requirement: Shared structured-data HTML returned-document family: code change, verification, research/design/report, preview/media and handoff, with actual content dominant and existing specialised renderers/native actions reused.
required_branches: Agents consume the structured record, not scraped HTML.
Required missing verification is visible; optional missing metrics/tabs are absent.
Native contained HTML opening and existing Day/Dialogue/CT4b contracts are retained.
Raw-ref lists and unrelated bespoke pages do not satisfy template parity.

obligations.requirement: Handoff reading order: actual outcome/partial state, browsable changes/diff, verification incl outstanding, attributable runtime observations, remaining work/blocker/next step, 1–3 copyable canonical continuation prompts, collapsed provenance.
required_branches: Opening handoff does not launch a session.
Continue uses existing session or explicit new shared start interaction.
Queued Run with no attempt cannot yield fabricated completion.
Reported spend versus derived estimates retain their source/basis.

obligations.requirement: Source-faithful SSSF Run list/Run Map/frontier, actual correlated Live work, waterfall/span/tool/process/permission/evidence trajectory and supplied Run Thought; selection opens exact environment or artifact; canonical repair/evidence/recognise/continue.
required_branches: Show required missing/failed verification and independent legs.
Source/semantic to exact execution/evidence remains navigable.
Queued Run plus unrelated chat/tmux is not Factory execution.
Agent completion, human acceptance and Git integration stay separate.

obligations.requirement: All code-bearing session/Run/change/handoff views refer to real repository/worktree and comparison basis; statistics/diff use native reads, checks retain exact tested revision/working state, native CLI changes reconcile.
required_branches: Preserve human dirty/staged/unstaged/untracked work.
Committed, staged and working comparisons remain identifiable.
Later edits expose stale evidence rather than leaving green on unspecified code.
Consume existing observation and finish required public diff/history seams in AIKit#137.

obligations.requirement: Quiet footer to session switcher/Observatory and same-session alternate Surface; children roll up, attention deep-links exact pending act, Gateway System/Inspect depth and scoped reachability recovery retain native semantics.
required_branches: No top Factory horizon or generic transport chrome.
Progress is Activity, not Inbox flooding.
Available/working/needs-input/failure retain actual native evidence.
Supported connection recovery preserves current work; no broader authority follows visibility.

obligations.requirement: NOW/Inbox/DAY reference actual scratch/work/handoffs/questions/results with retained time/lineage; configure recurring Agent/developmental responsibility via current Routine proof/permission/provider contracts and actual activity/results.
required_branches: No duplicate Factory temporal/event database or midnight scheduling.
Stale proof or revoked authority blocks unattended consequential effects.
Duplicate trigger/restart must not duplicate effects.
Ordinary recurrence remains quiet; consequential blockage becomes attention.

obligations.requirement: Use actual running app, current tokens and content-first surfaces; one compact control area without stacked Runs/Build headers; outcome-first handoff and artifact-first preview; useful empty/error states, keyboard/pointer, narrow widths, focus/drafts and native Linux menu.
required_branches: Global Expression Stage only; reduced/interrupted motion keeps interaction usable.
One pane's failure preserves unrelated usable work.
Absent controls do not silently remove required implementation obligations.
Screenshots or source tests alone do not establish human visual acceptance.

obligations.requirement: Run the complete connected Agent→Factory→bounded child→exact environment→Git/preview/verification/handoff→correction→restart→NOW/recurrence walk; preserve Epi/Nara/Factory and Direct/external identities; independently verify whole feature.
required_branches: Actual scoped Factory authority must cross Actuation's existing gate.
Use all available admitted harnesses with economical eligible models and actual supported faculties; record unsupported/unavailable/failure separately.
Keep exact source/build/install/running and failed evidence.
No partial smoke, prose or generated human verdict closes the whole.

closure: Each required branch remains unexercised until exact source-qualified native execution and appropriate provider/material/human evidence exist. #289 implements; #201/#202–205 prove; #65 retains whole campaign scope.
